purpose: Black-box recall of tools/classify.py. Every case is an observation a solver could plausibly type before reading source. The first five come from chains verified live in this repository on 2026-09-26, so their labels are not opinion; the rest are ordinary phrasings of classes the taxonomy already claims to cover.
why_this_exists: Five separate times the classifier returned nothing useful on a real black-box challenge while its source_signals worked fine. The gap is on the observation side only. This file is the measurement that decides whether a signal edit actually helped.
scoring: a case passes when the expected class appears in the candidates; a case whose expect is null passes only when the classifier returns NOTHING, so recall cannot be bought by widening signals
